# OpenVMM runtime: second release candidate

This release includes all changes from v0.6.0-rc1 and fixes two output issues:

- Shared-directory listings now report non-zero inode numbers. This prevents
  glibc versions before 2.37 from silently skipping entries, which made mounted
  directories appear empty in affected guest images.
- Cyclic stdout/stderr pipes now apply backpressure when full instead of
  dropping older bytes. The guest pauses reads until the runtime drains the
  buffer, preserving complete output even with a small configured capacity.

Regression coverage checks visible directory entries with non-zero inodes,
paused-pipe recovery for both pipe modes, and complete stdout/stderr through
17-byte cyclic buffers in the real-VM integration suite.

The release workflow builds the Linux guest once and includes the same kernel
and initramfs in both Linux and Windows packages. Publication requires native
checks on both platforms and the Linux KVM integration suite. Actual Windows
WHP VM execution remains unverified. GPU passthrough is outside this release's
scope.
